remarks: Rarely does a property of this caliber become available! Situated on approximately 6 picturesque acres, this extraordinary multi-use estate offers the perfect combination of luxury living, business opportunities, and income potential. Whether you're an entrepreneur, investor, or looking for a private family compound, the possibilities are endless. The centerpiece is a stunning, completely updated 4,020 sq. ft. home showcasing beautiful natural woodwork and modern finishes throughout. The heart of the home features an incredible 1,000+ sq. ft. open-concept kitchen, formal dining area, two living rooms, and a four-season sunroom, all warmed by three cozy fireplaces. Step outside to a welcoming covered porch, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Upstairs you'll find four spacious bedrooms, each with generous 4' x 6' closets. The spectacular 550 sq. ft. primary suite boasts 12' cathedral ceilings, a luxurious two-person 4' x 8' walk-in shower, an oversized walk-in closet complete with its own dressing room and built-in bureau, plus the convenience of a second-floor laundry room. A third-floor loft makes an ideal office, studio, or playroom, while the full basement with radiant heated floors and partially finished space offers endless possibilities. Beyond the home, this remarkable estate includes a separate five-station beauty salon, two detached income-producing rental buildings, a large five-bay automotive repair shop, a magnificent two-story timber-frame barn with exceptional craftsmanship, and an additional storage barn. Whether you choose to operate your own businesses, generate multiple rental incomes, expand your investment portfolio, or simply enjoy the privacy and versatility of this incredible property, opportunities like this are exceptionally rare. Luxury, craftsmanship, income potential, and endless possibilities—all in one unforgettable property. For more info and pictures for the entire property, see Mls #R1697031, #R1697048, R1697184
